  Scenario: AC7 Each business rule BR1 to BR8 is verified by a named criterion or test (new, D-RCV-60)

    When each rule BR1 to BR8 is read against section 7 and section 16
    Then BR1, BR2, BR3 and BR6 are verified by AC1, AC3, AC2 and AC6
    Then BR4, BR5, BR7 and BR8 are verified by TC-PLT-E1071-CON-07 and AC2, and every rule has at least one test case row

  Scenario: AC8 A retried or timed-out activity never writes a second decision code (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given PlatformSmokeActivity is retried or exceeds the completion bound of AC4
    When the fake worker runs the smoke workflow with a forced retry and a forced timeout
    Then the activity writes decision code PLATFORM_SMOKE at most once for the workflow ID platform-smoke-{yyyymmdd}
    Then the workflow completes within 60 seconds or is reported as failed, and the retry count and backoff are Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-PLT-E1071-CON-AC8)
